title: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
degree_levels: Non-degree, Bachelor's, Master's, One-tier Master's, Doctoral
eligibility_summary: Available to citizens of partner countries with bilateral educational agreements with Hungary (90+ countries); must be nominated by sending partner; not a Hungarian citizen; minimum 56/100 on entrance exam; only 2 program choices allowed
funding_details: Tuition-free education; Monthly stipend HUF 43,700 (~EUR 110) for BA/BSc/MA/MSc/non-degree and HUF 140,000-180,000/month for Doctoral; Free dormitory OR HUF 40,000/month accommodation contribution; Medical insurance (HUF 65,000/year supplementary); One-off travel allowance HUF 330,000 for applicants 8,000+ km from Budapest; Hungary Pass
duration: 12 months per year until completion of studies

title: Hungarian Bilateral State Scholarships
provider: Tempus Public Foundation / Hungarian State (Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade)
degree_levels: Full degree (Bachelor's, Master's, Doctoral), Partial/semester studies, Postgraduate study visits, Postdoctoral study visits, Summer courses
application_deadline: 19 February 2026, 23:00 CET (27 February 2026, 17:00 for summer courses)
eligibility_summary: Based on bilateral educational agreements between Hungary and partner countries; applicants must be enrolled or accepted at a Hungarian higher education institution; applications via https://scholarship.hu/; scholarship paid by receiving institution or sending country
funding_details: Tuition-free education; Stipend: HUF 56,600/month for Bachelor's/Master's; HUF 140,000/month (1st-2nd year) and HUF 180,000/month (3rd-4th year) for Doctoral; Accommodation allowance: HUF 40,000/month or dormitory placement; Postgraduate visits: HUF 80,000/month + HUF 70,000 accommodation; Postdoctoral visits: HUF 120,000/month + HUF 80,000 accommodation
duration: Full academic year (September - June); study visits up to 10 months

title: Momentum MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowship
provider: Hungarian Academy of Sciences (MTA), co-funded by European Commission
degree_levels: Postdoctoral researchers (PhD holders) at MTA Lendület/Momentum research groups
funding_type: Employment contract with full social security
eligibility_summary: Doctoral degree or successful thesis defense by deadline; MSCA mobility rule: max 12 months in Hungary in past 3 years; not employed by Lendület host at deadline; research at MTA Lendület/Momentum groups; up to ~17 full 36-month positions available
funding_details: Salary: EUR 3,522 gross/month (EUR 3,980 super-gross); Mobility allowance: EUR 150/month; Relocation allowance: up to EUR 3,600 one-time; Family allowance: EUR 300/month if applicable; Research budget: up to EUR 1,800/month; Indirect costs: EUR 600/month at host; Full social security coverage; Special needs allowance available
duration: Up to 36 months (minimum 12 months) with mandatory 1-3 month international secondment

title: Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship
degree_levels: Non-degree, Bachelor's, Master's, One-tier Master's, Doctoral, Preparatory, Foundation Year, Summer courses
application_deadline: 2 February 2026, 14:00 CET (missing documents accepted until 1 August 2026)
eligibility_summary: For ethnic Hungarians and descendants living in diaspora communities outside the EU, Republic of Serbia, and Zakarpattia (Ukraine); must obtain recommendation from local Hungarian diaspora organization or diplomatic representation; application via https://apply.diasporascholarship.hu/
funding_details: Tuition-free education; Monthly stipend HUF 43,700 (~EUR 120) for BA/BSc/MA/MSc and HUF 140,000-180,000/month for Doctoral; Free dormitory OR HUF 40,000/month accommodation contribution; One-off travel allowance HUF 330,000 for 8,000+ km from Budapest; Hungary Pass; Health contribution HUF 65,000/year; PhD completion bonus HUF 400,000
duration: 12 months per year for the whole duration of scholarship period

title: Semmelweis Pannonia In Excellence Scholarship
degree_levels: Bachelor's, Master's, One-tier Master's (at Semmelweis University faculties)
eligibility_summary: Foreign nationals holding student status at Semmelweis University; enrolled in English or German-taught programs; began studies September 2024 or later; NOT recipients of Stipendium Hungaricum or Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship; based on academic progress and achievements in sports/arts
funding_details: Annual amounts by faculty: HUF 2,000,000 (Medicine, Dentistry), HUF 1,300,000 (Pharmaceutical Sciences), HUF 900,000 (Health Sciences), HUF 2,900,000 (András Pető Faculty); Paid in 12 equal monthly installments; Active student status required
